name: What are the common challenges or considerations when installing a skylight?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges or considerations when installing a skylight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skylight installation involves critical considerations such as proper flashing to prevent leaks, structural integrity of the roof, and ensuring effective insulation and ventilation to avoid condensation. Integrating a skylight into an existing structure requires careful planning to match interior finishes and exterior roofing materials seamlessly. Our design-build approach at AKN Design Group addresses these challenges holistically, coordinating all aspects from structural changes to aesthetic integration, minimizing potential issues and ensuring a lasting result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include preventing leaks, ensuring structural integrity, and proper insulation. Our design-build process coordinates all aspects for seamless integration and lasting results.
